text: 69-year-old male. The patient presents with pain in his left great toe, hips, and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest. He reports that the symptoms have progressively gotten worse over the past several years.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis of the hips and knees with suspected gouty arthritis of the left first MTP joint.

The clinical picture of activity-related pain in weight-bearing joints in a 69-year-old male with obesity strongly supports osteoarthritis. However, your history of daily alcohol use and recent unprotected travel raises a significant concern for sexually transmitted infections like syphilis or reactive arthritis, which can also affect the great toe and joints.
